title: Computation Note on the Early-Termination Charge — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**The charge.** Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, the early-termination charge for a termination notice on record is the tier's early-termination fee in full when the termination takes effect before the end of the initial term, and nothing when it takes effect on or after that end. The charge is booked on the date the notice was received, rounded to the cent.

## Quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Definition | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| Notice date | the request date of the client's most recent termination notice service request | the client's service requests |
| Named date | the effective date the client names in that termination notice | the same service request |
| Effective date of the termination | the later of the notice date plus the tier's termination notice in calendar days, and the named date | derived |
| End of the initial term | the agreement's term end date, while the agreement has not renewed | the agreement record |
| Renewed | the agreement has renewed when its term end date lies the tier's initial term in months, or more, whole months after its effective date; a termination of a renewed agreement takes effect after the initial term and carries no charge | the agreement record |
| Early-termination fee | the tier's early-termination fee | the tier figure of the agreement's tier |

## Assembly

1. The notice date and the named date are those of the termination notice on record.
2. The termination takes effect on the later of the notice date plus the tier's termination notice days and the named date.
3. On an agreement that has renewed, the charge is nothing.
4. On an agreement that has not renewed, the charge is the tier's early-termination fee in full when the effective date falls before the agreement's term end date, and nothing when it falls on or after the term end date.
5. The charge is rounded to the cent and stands on the notice date.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Inputs common to both cases: an agreement on a tier whose early-termination fee is 1500.00 USD and whose termination notice is 60 calendar days, initial term 12 months; effective date 2025-06-01; term end date 2026-05-31, which lies 11 whole months after the effective date, so the agreement has not renewed.

*Case A.* Termination notice received 2026-01-10, naming 2026-02-01. The notice date plus 60 days is 2026-03-11, later than the named date, so the termination takes effect on 2026-03-11. That is before 2026-05-31, so the charge is 1500.00 USD, booked on 2026-01-10.

*Case B.* Termination notice received 2026-04-15, naming no later date. The notice date plus 60 days is 2026-06-14, after the term end date, so the charge is nothing.

*Case C.* The same agreement with a term end date of 2027-05-31: that date lies 23 whole months after the effective date, 12 or more, so the agreement has renewed and the charge is nothing.
